settings.title: What can happen if I don't control my blood sugar levels?
settings.content:
Elevated blood sugar levels aren’t just bad for the waistline - they can wreak havoc on your health and longevity.

When excess blood sugar floats around in the blood, it damages blood vessels. This can lead to deteriorating vision, kidney problems, skin issues… and even poor circulation, numb fingers and toes, poorly healing wounds, and heart problems.

So if you want to drop extra pounds more easily, look slimmer, and stay healthy as you age, it’s essential to control your blood sugar levels.

settings.title: How do I know if my blood sugar levels are elevated?
settings.content:
If you’re over 30, the beta cells you need to maintain healthy blood sugar levels decline in number and function. That’s why it’s increasingly common to suffer from blood sugar concerns as we age.

Combine that with our modern, busy lives and processed foods that spike your blood sugar levels… and there’s a very good chance you could have unhealthy levels and not even know about it.

The only sure way to know if your blood sugar is too high is to do a test. It’s a good idea to ask your healthcare provider about it.

Other signs that could point to elevated blood sugar levels include: frequent urination, fatigue, increased thirst or hunger, blurred vision, numb extremities, slow healing wounds, and headaches.

settings.title: How can I get the best results with Extrim Shape?
settings.content:
In an ideal world, you’d exercise a few times per week and eat a healthy, balanced diet.

But Extrim Shape is designed for our busy, modern lives - so you don’t need to change a thing to see results.

settings.title: What can I expect when taking Extrim Shape?
settings.content:
In the first 90 days, patients in an Extrim study saw an average 15-point drop in blood sugar levels.

And within just the first 2 weeks, patients reported freedom from brain fog and improved energy… regular bowel movements without constipation… and the total elimination of cravings for sweets.

Better yet, nearly everyone showed a decrease in fat storage in the liver - without making any changes in their diets. This is a sign that their bodies stopped storing fat due to elevated blood sugar.

When you control your blood sugar levels, you may notice that it’s easier to drop those extra pounds, clothing sizes, and stay healthy as you age.

settings.title: Will Extrim Shape help with weight management?
settings.content:
If you’re over 30 or struggle with high blood sugar levels, Extrim Shape can make it easier to control your weight.

It’s not a miracle that makes you drop 5 pounds in one week. But unlike 80% of diet results, which are shown to reverse within 2 years… the results from Extrim Shape are sure — and they actually last.

settings.title: Is Extrim Shape an appetite suppressant?
settings.content:
The formula works in several ways to naturally regulate your appetite, reduce cravings, and make you feel full.

The formula works to regulate blood sugar spikes that result in cravings. It works to absorb fluids and expand in your stomach so you feel full. And it includes multiple nutrients that combine to do this work in several different ways.
